channel.title: Hostile Input
channel.description: Every place an author can hand the theme a value that ends up in an attribute, filled with values made to break out of it: Boxes - button, callout, badge and icon Figure - Hugo’s figure shortcode, drawn by the theme Images and Links - the partials behind the image and link render hooks Markdown - the render hooks, reached through Markdown alone Front Matter - a title and terms, which reach menu, breadcrumbs and lists Resources - a file name the theme turns into a link Cards - URLs a card runs or links Menu URL and Menu Page Ref - where a page’s menu entry leads instead, next to a menu from the configuration

item.title: "><script>alert(1)</script> Front Matter
item.description: A title and terms, which the theme writes into the menu, the breadcrumbs, the document title, the neighbouring pages’ navigation and the term lists.

item.title: Resources
item.description: A file name the theme turns into a link: its spaces must not end the link, a colon must not make it a scheme and an entity must not be decoded. A % or # is left out, as Hugo itself can not give such a resource a URL. A file name can not hold a colon everywhere, so those names are given in front matter. Attachments a file & more.txt (28 B) c:notes.txt (27 B) javascript:alert(1).txt (32 B) x<y.txt (29 B)

item.title: Cards
item.description: A card runs the code of a script URL however it is spelled, and links any other URL like the link shortcode does. Script Runs code Mixed case Runs code No code Runs nothing, still no link Phone Keeps its scheme Entities Keeps its query Blank Links nowhere An image as data URL

item.title: Menu URL
item.description: Its menu entry leads to a script URL given in front matter.

item.title: Menu Page Ref
item.description: Its menu entry leads to another page given in front matter.
